valhalla-routing.name: Valhalla Routing Service
valhalla-routing.description: REST API for origin-destination routing using the Valhalla routing engine. Provides turn-by-turn directions, distance, duration, and geometry for routes between locations. Supports multiple costing models (auto, bicycle, pedestrian, transit) and can avoid features like tolls, ferries, and highways.

GET /route.capability: Calculate the optimal route between an origin and destination. Returns trip distance, duration, legs, and geometry. Parameters include locations (comma-separated lat,lng pairs), costing model, and optional avoid_features.

valhalla-roadblocks.name: Valhalla Roadblock-Aware Routing
valhalla-roadblocks.description: REST API for origin-destination routing that accounts for roadblocks, road closures, and construction zones. Returns routes that avoid blocked roads and provides alternative paths. Particularly useful for comparing standard routing vs roadblock-mitigated routing.

GET /route.capability: Calculate a route between origin and destination that avoids known roadblocks and closures. Returns trip distance, duration, legs, geometry, and the number of roadblocks avoided.
